reason: Not the suite-uninstall chassis (which computes a bundle's removal set from its own dependencies array and a provenance split of installed_plugins.json, then confirms). This plugin has no dependencies key — it is a leaf — and its uninstall is a thin relay over scripts/all-plugins.sh, which removes every leaf of the marketplace from one scope with no confirmation and reports an exit code; the marketplace manifest, not a bundle manifest, is the list.
